pay-permit-within-mandate.label: Within mandate
pay-permit-within-mandate.explain: The payment is one the user authorised, to an active vendor, for an amount within the cap they set.

pay-account-must-be-master.label: Account not on file
pay-account-must-be-master.explain: Payments can only go to the bank account held in the vendor master. This account came from external content, so it cannot be used — human approval does not change that.

pay-vendor-match-required.label: Vendor not verified
pay-vendor-match-required.explain: The invoice GSTIN, the sender's domain and the DKIM result did not all agree on the same vendor. A human can approve it after checking.

pay-no-duplicates.label: Duplicate invoice
pay-no-duplicates.explain: This vendor and invoice number were already settled or are already pending, so paying again would be a double payment.

pay-above-auto-limit-needs-human.label: Above auto-approve limit
pay-above-auto-limit-needs-human.explain: The amount is above the limit for automatic payment, so it needs a person to approve it.

email-permit-within-mandate.label: Sending allowed
email-permit-within-mandate.explain: The user's mandate includes sending email.

email-recipient-must-be-trusted.label: Recipient not recognised
email-recipient-must-be-trusted.explain: The recipient is neither an internal address nor a contact in the vendor master, and the address itself came from external content.

email-confidential-internal-only.label: Confidential stays internal
email-confidential-internal-only.explain: This message carries confidential company data, so it can only go to an internal address.

read-tools-allowed.label: Read-only tool
read-tools-allowed.explain: Reading, looking up and flagging do not move money or send anything, so they are permitted.
